name: Viciuslab
noteEs: Canal español dedicado a Dota 2 con guías de héroes, gameplays comentados de top players y cobertura de torneos. Una de las pocas referencias activas en español con producción consistente y enfoque pedagógico. Para hispanohablantes que prefieren contenido en su idioma sin perder calidad técnica, Viciuslab es la primera parada del ecosistema español de Dota 2.
noteEn: Spanish channel dedicated to Dota 2 with hero guides, commented gameplays from top players, and tournament coverage. One of the few active Spanish-language references with consistent production and pedagogical focus. For Spanish speakers preferring content in their language without losing technical quality, Viciuslab is the first stop of the Spanish Dota 2 ecosystem.
highlightsEs: Referencia activa en español con producción consistente
Guías de héroes y gameplays comentados de top players
Cobertura de torneos importantes en español
Enfoque pedagógico accesible para beginners e intermedios
highlightsEn: Active Spanish-language reference with consistent production
Hero guides and commented gameplays from top players
Coverage of major tournaments in Spanish
Accessible pedagogical focus for beginners and intermediates
